title: My Favourite Animal
description: Practise have got, can and the present simple, and write about your favourite animal.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "have got" with plural nouns (they): elephants have got.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: A cat ___ (sleep) a lot in the day.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it, add -s to the verb: a cat sleeps.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + can + base verb + very + adverb: Dolphins can swim very fast.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My dog like playing with a ball.
answers: My dog likes playing with a ball.
exercises.explanation: My dog = it, so the verb needs -s: my dog likes.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "its" (no apostrophe) for something that belongs to an animal or thing. "It's" means "it is".

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There is three cats in my house.
answers: There are three cats in my house.
exercises.explanation: Use "there are" with plural nouns: there are three cats.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I like ___. They are very clever.
exercises.explanation: Use the plural (-s) to talk about animals in general: I like horses.

exercises.prompt: Write the negative form of be.
exercises.text: There ___ (not / be) any lions in my country.
exercises.explanation: Use "there aren't" (are not) with plural nouns: there aren't any lions.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Use "are" with plural nouns: penguins are.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My cat has got a long tail.
Has my cat got a long tail?
exercises.explanation: Use "has got" with he, she and it: My cat has got a long tail.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Penguins ___ fly, but they can swim.
exercises.explanation: Use "can't" + verb for things you are not able to do: penguins can't fly.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.explanation: With plural nouns (they), use the base form of the verb: rabbits eat.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" for a surface: on my bed, on the sofa.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My grandmas dog is very old.
answers: My grandma's dog is very old.
exercises.explanation: Add 's to a person to show that something belongs to them: my grandma's dog.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My dog loves running in the park.
In the park my dog loves running.
exercises.explanation: Love + verb-ing: My dog loves running.

exercises.prompt: Complete the question with Do or Does.
exercises.explanation: Use "Does" in questions with he, she and it: Does your dog like ...?

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I love dogs ___ they are friendly.
exercises.explanation: Use "because" to give a reason.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My favourite animal is a elephant.
answers: My favourite animal is an elephant.
exercises.explanation: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an elephant.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My rabbit eats carrots every day.
Every day my rabbit eats carrots.
exercises.explanation: With he, she and it, add -s to the verb: my rabbit eats.

exercises.prompt: Write in, on or at.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" with parts of the day: in the day, in the morning.

contentPoints: Say what your favourite animal is.
task.modelAnswer: My favourite animal is the panda. It is black and white and it has got small ears. Pandas live in China. They can climb trees and they like eating bamboo. I like pandas because they are big, soft and very funny.
